quiensoy.p1: I'm Brayan Albadam, a digital designer trained at Universidad Politécnico Grancolombiano, with UX certifications from Google and in user and consumer experience design from Universidad San Buenaventura Cali, complemented by studies in web application development at Universidad Industrial de Santander.
quiensoy.p2: My work combines design and development: I've built brand identities for companies and professionals, developed WordPress interfaces, and led the user experience for an educational platform on CANVAS LMS for farmers in Central America, where design was key to overcoming barriers to accessibility and technology adoption.
quiensoy.p3: As Project Manager on a project with the Ministry of ICT, Apps.CO and Universidad ICESI, I coordinated design and development teams to deliver 74 MVPs in Cycle 2 of the Apps.Co Project — Digital Product Phase, meeting deadlines and quality standards.
quiensoy.p4: I was a semifinalist in the brand redesign contest for Mexico's Felipe Ángeles International Airport and took part in Bancolombia's Bank Design 2023 challenge, two experiences that tested my judgment under real pressure.
quiensoy.p5: I apply Design Thinking to uncover real problems, translate them into clear solutions, and build experiences people actually want to use.

items.titulo: Diploma in Programming, Software Development with a focus on Web Applications
items.descripcion: Diploma in Python programming with the Django framework, web application development in HTML, CSS, React, architecture design with UML diagrams, databases.

Following the design process: empathizing with users, defining pain points, proposing solutions, creating prototypes, testing designs and iterating. Applying core UX concepts, such as user-centered design, accessibility and equity. Planning research studies, conducting interviews and usability studies, and synthesizing research findings.

items.titulo: User and Consumer Experience Design UX-CX
items.descripcion: Creating digital products that deliver a strong user experience by considering client-side experience factors to meet needs through design, applying methodologies such as design thinking.
Additional studies in digital image production, digital marketing, online community management, web development, e-commerce, and application of SCRUM methodologies for software projects.

descripcion: Designed and developed WordPress websites for projects such as NUI Experience and Afroproyectos, ensuring an intuitive user experience aligned with business goals.

Led frontend implementation on CANVAS LMS for an agricultural education project aimed at users in El Salvador, Honduras and Guatemala, taking part in user experience design, API integration and data retrieval, creation of learning modules, CSV record management, and interface implementation using HTML and CSS.
Conducted usability testing alongside the Learning Experience team to evaluate how farmers interacted with the platform and identify opportunities to improve the user experience.
Designed user flows, task flows and use cases for the PRM learning system and its courses, optimizing user journeys and supporting the fulfillment of learning objectives.

Supported design and prototyping processes by creating and updating interfaces in Figma, later collaborating on their implementation on the platform using HTML and CSS to ensure consistency between design and development.

items.empresa: Ministry of ICT | Innpulsa | Universidad ICESI
descripcion: Mid-level project lead, responsible for managing the activities carried out by designers and developers to deliver, within the established timelines, the 74 minimum viable products that were part of Cycle 2 of the Apps.Co Project — Digital Product Phase.

Provided UX consulting services, user experience design, and brand creation for companies, professionals and institutions, helping them scale and understand user needs through the design of digital products and services.
Brand and packaging design for Ecocomfort, a company producing handmade household goods.
UX/UI design of the Playme web app in the content entertainment sector. Designed flows, UI kit, components, and statistics and payments dashboard.
Conducted user research, usability testing and data analysis to understand audience behavior and inform design decisions.
Developed user personas, journey maps and wireframes to ensure a thorough understanding of user needs and behaviors.
Implemented interactive prototypes that clearly conveyed the flow and functionality of digital products.
Designed visually compelling interfaces aligned with brand identity and marketing goals.
Developed design systems, style guides and component libraries to maintain consistency across all digital touchpoints.
Collaborated with developers to ensure design integrity was maintained throughout the development phase.
